iti24:1.1: (Ek. III.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti24:2.1: Ekapuggalassa bhikkhave kappaṃ sandhāvato saṃsarato siyā evaṃ mahā aṭṭhikaṅkalo aṭṭhipuñjo aṭṭhirāsi yathāyaṃ vepullapabbato, sace saṃhārako assa, sambhatañca na vinasseyyā-ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti24:3.1: Ekass-ekena kappena puggalass-aṭṭhisañcayo | siyā pabbatasamo rāsi iti vuttaṃ mahesinā ||
iti24:4.1: So kho panāyaṃ akkhāto vepullo pabbato mahā | uttaro Gijjhakūṭassa Magadhānaṃ Giribbaje ||
iti24:5.1: Yato ca ariyasaccāni sammappaññāya passati || dukkhaṃ dukkhasamuppādaṃ dukkhassa ca atikkamaṃ | ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ dukkhūpasamagāminaṃ ||
iti24:6.1: sa sattakkhattuṃ paramaṃ sandhāvitvāna puggalo | dukkhassantakaro hoti sabbasaṃyojanakkhayā ti ||
iti24:7.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||4||
